settlement_source: NEWROLE: NVIDIA (board, press release, SEC filing, website) plus NYT, AP, Bloomberg, Reuters, Axios, Politico, Semafor, The Information, WaPo, WSJ, TechCrunch, Wired, ABC, CBS, CNN, Fox, MSNBC, NBC, ESPN, The Athletic.
settlement_variable: Whether the named person is officially appointed, elected, named, designated or succeeded as permanent CEO of NVIDIA after issuance and before 2029-01-01.
timezone: ET (expiration 10:00 AM ET; Last Trading Time 11:59 PM ET the day before <date>)
tie_handling: If several persons are simultaneously first appointed and have markets, each pays $1 / number of such persons.
trading_close_vs_settlement: close_time = expiration_time = 2029-01-01T05:00Z (midnight ET 1 Jan 2029). Rulebook: last trading day before <date>, 11:59 PM ET; latest expiration one week after <date>. can_close_early=1: on announcement expiration moves earlier (Rule 7.2). settlement_timer 1800s.
early_close_or_void_clauses: Announcement alone suffices; later resignation/death irrelevant. Interim/acting roles, rumors and conditional appointments don't count (regulatory/shareholder approval excepted). If NVIDIA ceases to exist or CEO role is eliminated, all candidates No. Kalshi may start Market Outcome Review at sole discretion (NEWROLE cites Rule 6.3(d)/6.3(b), unlike other rulebooks citing 7.1).
title_vs_rules_divergences: Title 'next CEO' implies succession of the current CEO; the rule is the first new CEO appointment after issuance and before 2029-01-01. If no appointment occurs, all resolve No.
rules_secondary says an official NVIDIA announcement is sufficient; the rulebook also accepts listed major media sources as Source Agencies, so reported appointments may be argued as sufficient.
Candidate list includes non-NVIDIA persons (e.g., Tim Cook).

public_feeds_for_settlement_variable.name: SEC EDGAR NVIDIA 8-K
public_feeds_for_settlement_variable.latency: up to 4 business days, usually same day

toxicity_flags: Board/executive insiders hold MNPI; only the prohibition list protects
notes: Only the Colette Kress sample market was read; order books not examined. One-off series.
